initialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production twelve-pose full-character animation atlas, not a video.
Reference image 1 is identity and exact art-style reference. Preserve that exact polarbear, its silhouette, proportions, facial expression, colors, low-poly faceted dimensional shading and markings. Do not invent a new character or photorealistic rendering.
Make a genuinely transparent RGBA sprite atlas at 2048 x 2048 resolution, arranged EXACTLY THREE equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 12 cells in row-major order. All cells have exactly equal width and height; no borders, labels, numbers, text, watermarks, floor, cast shadows, props or colored backgrounds. All twelve complete characters face LEFT in the same slight three-quarter SIDE view. Each body must fit its own cell with 7% horizontal breathing room and 10% head margin; no pixels cross cell borders. Torso reference center at local x 55%, shoulder height at local y 39%, the shared paw-ground line at local y 88%. Lock body size, camera, torso center, baseline and perspective across all twelve poses: do NOT re-center or re-scale each pose's silhouette. Whole anatomy stays connected.
IMPORTANT four-legged anatomy: preserve both forelegs and both hindlegs in every drawing. Near legs are distinct from the slightly darker far legs; far paws should be distinguishable where unoccluded. Hind legs bend correctly at the hock; paws plant flat. No amputated, floating, duplicate or straight stick legs. No synchronized same forelegs swing. No rubber stretching.
The twelve drawings are genuinely distinct hand-authored animation key poses, with a coherent chronological cycle:
Cell 0: quiet original standing pose, four paws supported.
Cells 1–8: ONE COMPLETE SLOW NATURAL FOUR-BEAT WALK cycle. Sequential footfall order near hind -> near fore -> far hind -> far fore. Only ONE foot swings at a time; the other three support weight. Alternate near and far sides; no airborne phase, no jogging. In 1 near hind begins lifting from its rear position; 2 near hind bends and steps forward while other three paws support; 3 near hind has landed forward as near fore begins forward recovery; 4 near fore lands farther LEFT and far hind lifts; 5 far hind advances with a correctly bent hock; 6 far hind lands and far fore lifts; 7 far fore reaches forward LEFT; 8 far fore lands and near hind is finishing rearward support, naturally ready for cell 1. Supporting feet drift rearward in character coordinates through the eight-cycle poses, while torso stays registered. Draw a cyclic foot progression, NEVER simply extend legs then reverse the earlier poses.
Cell 9: four paws land and body settles back toward standing.
Cell 10: head gently reaches LEFT a little and nose sniffs, heavy shoulders quiet; four-legged support, no extra animal.
Cell 11: EXACT same standing drawing and registration as cell 0.
Keep subtle weight transfer only, never exaggerated bobbing or head snapping. Render the entire character afresh in every pose, including fur/body/neck connections. Clean smooth transparent edges. Prioritize correct anatomy and coherent gait over adding ornament.
repairPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent eight-pose whole-character animation sprite atlas for a toddler game.
Reference image 1 defines identity and exact art style. Keep this SAME character, its body proportions, silhouette, facial expression, colors, markings and dimensional LOW-POLY faceted shading. No photorealism, no 2D flat outlines.
Create a PORTRAIT transparent RGBA atlas, ideally 1536 x 2048. EXACTLY TWO equal columns by FOUR equal rows = EIGHT cells, row-major reading order. No ninth character. No grid lines, numbers, labels, watermark, scenery, floor, cast shadows or props. Truly transparent empty areas; remove every isolated background speck, colorful fringe, white remnant or mosaic inherited from the reference.
All eight characters FACE LEFT in the same slight three-quarter side view. Complete body and FOUR LEGS in every cell. Near limbs distinct from the darker far limbs; overlapping limbs allowed but no missing legs or floating disconnected paws. ALL body parts attached correctly. The two front feet must be staggered, never identical/synchronized.
REGISTRATION: each cell has identical size. Body anchor at local x 55%, paws on fixed ground line local y 88%, top at about y 16%, entire character fits inside 8% horizontal cell margins. Body width, torso center, shoulder height, camera and perspective MUST stay identical across eight cells. Do not center a differently shaped silhouette in each cell. Fixed-camera animation on a pegged drawing desk, transparent backdrop. Every pose is a separately drawn complete character, NOT cut-and-paste leg rotation, rubber stretching or mesh deformation.
Species: polarbear.
Draw ONE complete cyclic NATURAL FOUR-BEAT WALK in eight successive key poses, not an extension followed by reversed poses. Paws point LEFT as the animal travels forward left. Footfall order near hind -> near fore -> far hind -> far fore. One limb swings at a time, three support weight, no flight. Pose 0: near hind has just landed forward left below the rear abdomen, near fore stays behind its front shoulder, far hind in late support, far fore ahead; 1: near fore lifts and swings forward left with bent wrist; 2: near fore lands in front and far hind is lifting; 3: far hind bends at hock and travels forward; 4: far hind lands, far fore begins forward recovery; 5: far fore swings forward left while near fore stays in back support; 6: far fore lands and near hind lifts; 7: near hind swings forward left, naturally returning to pose0. Supporting feet progressively drift rearward relative to the fixed torso. Subtle shoulder/hip weight transfer, quiet head, gentle tail difference. Slow balanced steps and distinctly different limb states, no rigid duplicate drawings.
Reference image 2 is the previous atlas to repair. Change its layout to EXACTLY TWO columns FOUR rows and use only the eight cyclic walking poses. Keep character identity and low-poly style, enlarge each character appropriately within its cell, remove background noise entirely. Do not carry over stand/sniff/graze gesture cells from the twelve-pose sheet.

rowRegistration.reason: Generated equal-looking atlas row artwork uses a slightly smaller repeat spacing than canvasHeight/4. Apply a shared origin adjustment per two-cell row, never per-frame bbox normalization.

initialRejectedReason: 12-cell atlas too small; extra idle/gesture not suitable for the cyclic sequence.

visualQA.style: Matches original faceted low-poly cream bear / black-white dairy cow, no third style.
visualQA.completeBody: All cells include connected body/head/tail/limbs; far paws naturally occluded in some contact poses; no isolated limbs.
visualQA.motion: Eight successive walking key poses, not an idle/gesture/rest ping-pong. Both near/far forelimb recovery poses present.
visualQA.footfallReview: Rejected atlas: forepaw stride too small and near/far cycle not convincing. Independently redrawn pose PNGs replace this method.
visualQA.alignment: Torso drift from source row layout is recorded above; row origin registration required before acceptance.
visualQA.alpha: RGBA with actual transparency; low-alpha edge/noise inherited from reference. Clear alpha<16 in packer.
visualQA.clipping: All uniform source cells had 0 edge pixels with alpha>96.
